---
name: Adapter request
about: Ask for (or offer to build) support for another agent harness
title: "Adapter: <harness name>"
labels: adapter, help wanted
---

**Harness:** (name, link, version)

**Where does it store sessions?** (path pattern, file format such as JSONL or JSON, one file per session or many; mark guesses as unverified)

**What can it do?** (subagents, background shells, nested runs, plan or todo lists — anything that maps to nodes and events in [docs/ADAPTERS.md](../../docs/ADAPTERS.md))

**Can you share a fixture?** A short session with all personal data removed (usernames, paths, project names, emails, tokens, file contents). Please do not attach raw transcripts.

**Would you like to work on it?** yes / no / maybe
